title: At about 12, he built a chat program for his dad's dental office.
caption:
At about 12, he built a chat program for his dad's dental office.

In high school, AOL and Microsoft wanted to buy his music player. He said no.

At 22, he turned down Yahoo's $1 billion.

The day after his company went public, he married his college girlfriend.

That kid is Mark Zuckerberg. Forbes puts his net worth at about $220 billion.

Would you have taken Yahoo's billion?
